catalog.label: Enterprise Billing Investigation
catalog.instruction: Investigate the billing dispute for customer CUST-1042 covering August 1 through October 31, 2026. Retrieve the customer's account, subscriptions, invoices, payments, contracts, and support records. Identify duplicate payments, unauthorized subscription charges, and legitimate charges. Apply the refund policy, issue only authorized refunds, escalate exceptions requiring approval, update the support ticket, and prepare an itemized resolution with an audit trail. Never refund a legitimate charge or issue duplicate refunds.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Read the authorized customer account and caller identity.

tools.name: get_account_history
tools.description: Read account approvals, cancellations and dispute history.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: Read all three subscriptions. If stale, refresh by repeating this read before making decisions.

tools.name: get_plan_changes
tools.description: Read the recorded plan changes and cancellations for a subscription.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Read invoices with pagination. Follow next_cursor until null; limit defaults to 100.

tools.name: get_invoice_items
tools.description: Read the line items and authorization evidence for an invoice.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Read payments with pagination. Follow next_cursor until null. Failed/pending/reversed payments are not collected charges.

tools.name: get_payment_details
tools.description: Read one payment, its invoice obligation, status, collection time and dispute details.

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: Read the customer contract and policy identifier.

tools.name: get_refund_policy
tools.description: Read refund rules, automatic window and required authorization_context. Older disputed charges require approval and escalation.

tools.name: create_refund
tools.description: SIMULATED WRITE: issue a policy-authorized refund only. After a timeout retry with the SAME idempotency_key and payload. Never refund a legitimate charge. Authorization is enforced server-side.

tools.name: get_refund_status
tools.description: Read the actual persisted refund status after a refund request.

tools.name: get_tickets
tools.description: Read customer support records and the open billing-dispute ticket.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: SIMULATED WRITE: persist the itemized resolution: list every settled legitimate payment, authorized refunds and older disputed payments requiring approval; use escalated/pending_approval when any exception remains.

tools.name: create_audit_entry
tools.description: SIMULATED WRITE: append an evidence-based decision audit record using the simulated as_of time returned by the APIs.

statistics.uncertaintyNote: Seven fixed synthetic conditions and one customer; latency quantiles and bootstrap intervals are descriptive, not production tail-latency evidence.

limitations: Writes, inferred loops and branches are not supported by the compiler; only observed read regions may compile.

pricingBasis: No verified gemini-3.8-flash price configured. Monetary costs remain unknown, not zero.
